This is my favorite vitamin C serum I have used (which has been a lot in my quest to find the best and most affordable one). I love it! It doesnt like slough off like others Ive used.

avis.titre: The Best Vitamin C in Any Price Range -- The Azelaic Acid is
avis.texte: I used Cocokinds Vitamin C Glow Serum daily in the morning for 6 weeks. My skin is normal to dry, with occasional redness and sensitivity. Texture & Scent: Lightweight and silky, absorbs quickly. No fragrance or weird Vitamin C smell â€" if youve ever tried the SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic, you know the smell I mean! How it works with other products: No pilling under sunscreen or makeup. It layers well with moisturizers and my other morning serum, which is the Cocokind Chlorophyll Discoloration Serum. Results: My skin began appearing brighter, smoother, and more even within about 8-10 days of use. Over time, I have continued to notice that the glow is more apparent. As someone who will be 50 is 4 weeks, this is something I welcome. Irritation or Sensitivity: Zero. This is THE most gentle Vitamin C serums Ive used. Please dont mistake that for ineffective. That is the beauty of Cocokind products. While they are very gentle, they are still very effective. Would I repurchase? Absolutely. Its affordable, effective, and consistent.

avis.titre: Helps with my Post inflammatory hyperpigmentation
avis.texte: As someone with Asian melanated skin, my skin is heavily affected by post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (dark spots after a blemish heals). The hyperpigmentation can last months! What has helped me improve the healing of my PIHP spots is a daily dab of the vitamin C serum! I would also recommend the beginner retinol every few days for a few weeks during non-sunny months! I personally wouldnt use the retinol every day all year round. But if you want something long term and safe for daily use, this vitamin c serum is it!

This vitamin c leaves my skin feeling glowy and happy! I dont feel any irritation when I apply it and it doesnt make me break out - wins all around! My only hope is that one day it comes with an airless pump. But I will continue to purchase regardless!!
This is the only vitamin c Ive used that does not cause breakouts and leave my skin very glowy. I also love that it has azelaic acid!

MORNING: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Foaming Face Wash (does not leave my face feeling stripped or dry, size is worth the money) cocokind Vitamin C Glow Brightening Serum (sometimes there is a very slight burn but nothing that is concerning or leaves any after affects such as burns or spots on the face) Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Water Gel Moisturizer (was worried about using this product but my skin has been handling it perfectly) cocokind Daily SPF 32 Mineral Facial Sunscreen (no burn, as long as you use the right amount it does not cake on thick.
